fields.summary_ko.0: Fortinet (FTNT) stock has risen 160.5% over three years but increased volatility due to downward revision in services revenue guidance; currently at $129.39, trading approximately 11% below DCF-based fair value.
fields.summary_ko.1: Recent downward revision of services revenue guidance for three quarters has made long-term cash flow reliability a variable, while demand is strengthening in new growth areas such as AI security.
